name: com.kairos/kairos
title: Kairos Task Ledger MCP Server
description: The Kairos ambient action engine as MCP tools: submit transcripts, retrieve extracted action items with verbatim source quotes, and approve them for execution into Notion, Jira, Calendar, Linear, Todoist, GitHub Issues, Confluence pages, Google Tasks, Asana, ClickUp, email drafts, or the built-in Task Ledger. Plus the Postgres-backed Task Ledger MCP server as a standalone durable task destination.
